label: Unlinked readings from Ludwig Wittgenstein, Logisch-philosophische Abhandlung / Tractatus Logico-Ph
summary: TLP 6.44, Nicht wie die Welt ist, ist das Mystische, sondern dass sie ist: The contrast between how the world is and that it is marks an attitude toward existence. It supplies neither a positive account of why the world exists nor a premise about revelation or about whether a God proposition is cognitively meaningful.
